coordinate_contract.glb: glTF/Godot +Y up; export_yup=True performs the single conversion
coordinate_contract.module_root: identity; bounds-centered geometry; select named root, do not instantiate all overlapping modules

modules.scaling: Intentional XYZ building-mass scaling; keep cargo groups large, preserve shelf gaps and branch/camera openings.
Intentional architectural XYZ scaling only; the central opening is visual and creates no new traversable route.
Side assembly only; Z may be repeated/stretched deliberately, preserve X thickness and opening Y. Never place a deep downstand beneath shared bridge.
Approximate 24x62x22m candidate; prefer uniform scale, deliberate Y-only architectural adjustment allowed after checking all windows and supports.
Fit uniformly within existing obstacle bounds; intentional XYZ fit only to original width/height/depth. Do not alter gameplay collision.
Uniform scaling only; mount by measured centered bounds. Cyan lens is guide semantics, not a new boost.

collision_proxy_contract.placement: Apply the same module instance transform to each box; all coordinates include the exported bounds-centering offset.
collision_proxy_contract.granularity: One AABB per original solid box; diagonal beams/cylinders subdivided along axis into <=2m segments. Axis-aligned solids use one tight box.
collision_proxy_contract.solid_semantics: Union of part boxes; never substitute a module/material-mesh aggregate AABB. Windows, inter-floor gaps and frame cavities remain empty unless an original solid occupies them.
collision_proxy_contract.limitations: Conservative boxes can overestimate rotated/beveled corners and cylindrical edges; intersections need precise geometry follow-up. This metadata adds no runtime collision.
